name: source-harvest
description: Harvest external sources (video/URL/PDF/text) → structured extracts → cross-synthesis → confront THIS repo's doctrine+tree+issues → validate the leverageable points vs current web/academic evidence → ranked, operator-gated adopt-proposal. Files nothing without approval. Not deep-research (answers an open research question) and not a knowledge-vault (accumulates pages) — it confronts a specific repo and proposes what to adopt, then stops.
